description: Professional film storyboard / film still / character card design skill. Covers six-dimension shot language (shot type / camera position / movement / lighting / emotion / time) + 8 visual styles (cyberpunk, Hong Kong noir, IMAX epic, symmetrical candy color, Nordic minimal, 70s film, film noir, natural realism) + realistic/anime/3D medium style locks + character card layouts (three-/eight-view, expression sheet, pose library) + cross-shot identity consistency (Subject Identity Lock). Core capabilities: precise shot language, calibrated style setting, no medium drift, recognizable characters across shots.
